$comment: High or critical dependency advisories the CI audit leg accepts for a limited time: advisories with no fixed release that reach a workspace through development tooling alone (90 days at most), or, marked "production": true, advisories no release fixes for the major a production dependency pins (30 days at most). The rules are in .github/scripts/audit-gate.mjs and docs/security-architecture.md section 4a.

exceptions.reason: botbuilder 4.23.3 (latest; host-provided for the Teams channel plugin) and its botbuilder-core, botframework-connector and botframework-schema pin zod ^3.23.8, and the fix exists only in zod 4.6.6; forcing zod 4 makes botbuilder throw on load (z.object().nonstrict). The vulnerable code is the per-element issue accumulation of array schemas. Inbound Bot Framework requests reach zod only through CloudAdapter.process, which checks the body with z.record(z.unknown()) and never parses the array schemas in botframework-schema; the other parse calls validate configuration, sockets and callbacks, not request data. Remove this entry once botbuilder ships on zod 4.6.6 or later.
